# lgd-skill-review

> Six-dimension verifiability auditor for agent skills. Every deduction cites evidence; every result
> ships with a remediation order. Static mode: the target's code is never executed.

## what it answers
- skill audit / skill review / "is this skill safe to install"
- "why does my SKILL.md score low" / "what is missing"
- compare public skills on verifiability: https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-review/benchmark.html

## reproducibility
- engine: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skill-review/blob/main/scripts/review.py
- one-click mechanical fixes: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skill-review/blob/main/scripts/quickfix.py
- benchmark data: https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skill-review/blob/main/bench/leaderboard.json
- refreshed daily; every number rerunnable with `python bench.py`

## rubric (machine-readable, generated from the engine)
https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-reviewrubric.json — six weights, three blocking rules, sensitive patterns, verdicts, how to use.

## executed proof (static cap 96 -> 100)
https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-reviewrun-proof.json — our four packages scored with `review.py --run` (tests actually executed),
with timestamp and commit. This is the only number in the sample backed by a real run.

## rubric, item by item (23 checks)
https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-reviewrubric.json — every dimension broken into individual checks with points and the concrete fix.
第 6 维共 23 条判据，每条给了分值和「怎么修」；`drift_check` 保证判据之和等于引擎权重，文档不会悄悄和引擎脱节。

## re-review loop
Comment `/re-review` in the same issue to re-score after a fix; the bot replies with before -> after delta.
首次评审后，在同一 issue 留言 `/re-review` 即重评，回帖给出「改前 → 改后」分数变化。

## registry (verified list), machine-readable
https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-reviewregistry.json — three tiers by score (verified ≥90 / watch 60-89 / blocked <60), generated from the
benchmark. Admission rules, tier meaning and every entry in one file. Human page: https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-reviewregistry.html

## third-party audits, machine-readable
- https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-reviewaudits.json（两条真实大仓审计：分数、逐条 findings、整改顺序、复现命令）
- 人读版：https://zhaoxinghua09-cell.github.io/lgd-skill-reviewaudits.html

## submit a skill for review
https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skill-review/issues/new?template=review-request.yml

## limits
- measures verifiability, not usefulness or popularity
- static mode caps at 96 of 100; 100 needs the target's own tests to run
- snapshot in time; sample is not random

## current numbers
third-party top: 36 | lgd top: 96 | gap: 60
